name: Canon Score validation protocol

textbook.question: Does the Canon teach correct, checkable company analysis?
textbook.proof: dated sourced facts, checkable rules, worked examples, How Sure tables

model.question: Do higher scores lead to better company outcomes and better after-cost returns than simpler methods?
model.proof: frozen pre-registered forward records on unseen data vs rivals

records.universe: all listed commercial banks, all seven dimensions
records.repeat: annually, first NEPSE trading day of Magh, rubric version labelled

universe_expansion: development banks and finance companies from the second annual record
hydropower and insurers after Chapter 65 sets sector rules

banks: four-number rank: mean of ranks on ROE (high), gross NPL (low), capital cushion (high), P/B (low)
justified-value gap: ((ROE - 0.05)/(0.12 - 0.05)) / actual P/B; COE 12% and g 5% fixed for all banks
non_financials: Greenblatt-style rank: return on capital = EBIT/(net working capital + net fixed assets); earnings yield = EBIT/EV; combined ranks

outcomes.company_quality_12m: adverse event for lenders: gross NPL up > 1 percentage point; capital below minimum; cash dividend cut to zero; audit qualification; NRB problematic status
outcomes.return_12m_36m: price change + cash dividends, adjusted for bonus/rights, mergers followed at official swap ratio, after broker commission, SEBON and CDSC fees and capital gains tax in force; maximum drawdown reported

analysis.per_record: within-sector Spearman rank correlation of score vs outcome; top third vs bottom third
analysis.pooling: across records and sectors; single-year results reported as one observation, never a verdict

decision_rules.pass: after >= 3 annual records including a period with NEPSE index down >= 15% from peak: pooled rank correlation > 0 for both outcomes AND Canon >= best simple rival on after-cost return
decision_rules.fail: pooled correlation <= 0, or a simple rival better; book states it plainly; model track recommends the rival; Canon continues as a teaching checklist
decision_rules.otherwise: no clear signal yet; keep recording

protections: rubric changes apply only to later records, versioned and logged
all companies scored incl. later merged/failed/delisted
in-sample backtests labelled exploratory, never count toward a pass
each record, rival scores and outcomes published as data files
